protocol.architectureInitialization: Each one-block run starts from identical parameter arrays and fresh Adam moments. The two-block run copies the one-block initial w0, b0, head_w, and head_b; only its added w1 and b1 use the same fixed RNG stream. This isolates the added block from an accidental change to shared-layer initialization.
